blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings went from 53 to 43, and it took 21.5% of the city’s 298 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings went from 63 to 55, and it took 11.1% of the city’s 558 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Walnut Grove for detached houses in June, July, August, September (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July, August (a sellers’ best bet).

faq.a: Walnut Grove is a planned community and FVREB sub-area in the Township of Langley (not the City of Langley), north of Highway 1 across from Willoughby Heights, with its own Township community plan — Bylaw 1978 No. 1836, adopted November 26, 1979

faq.q: What recreation is in Walnut Grove?
faq.a: Walnut Grove Community Centre, the Township's community / recreation centre at 8889 Walnut Grove Drive, Langley Twp

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Walnut Grove than in June?
faq.a: Between June 2026 and September 2026, listings of houses fell from 53 to 43 and condos and townhomes fell from 63 to 55 in Walnut Grove.

faq.q: How big is Walnut Grove compared with the rest of Langley?
faq.a: In September 2026, Walnut Grove held 9.6% of the 449 houses listed in Langley and 7.9% of the 699 condos and townhomes listed in Langley.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Walnut Grove from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 64 houses and 62 condos and townhomes sold in Walnut Grove over those 4 months.
